basis: The chart's plotted data shows production starting at approximately 2,800 in 2018 and ending at approximately 2,500 in 2023. Although the title reads 'Increasing Production', the visual evidence of the line graph indicates a net decrease over the 2018-2023 period. The endpoint comparison (2018 vs 2023) is the standard measure for overall trend direction in this context, and the final value is lower than the initial value.
